$comment: Reference Code Scan run for lab 05, taken by the facilitator on 22 Oct 2026 against main (Normal effort, three lab-05 profiles). Titles, severities and statuses as shown in the Findings tab; use it when you cannot run scans yourself. Statuses are from the end of the run: 'dismissed' rows were dismissed by the scan's triage phase as duplicates, with the note shown.

scans.profile: Kadé Commerce — brand isolation and payment webhooks (lab 05)

findings.title: PayGate webhook HMAC computed but never compared — unauthenticated forged payment events
GET /orders/:orderId not scoped to caller's brand (cross-brand order read)
Client-chosen X-Kade-Role header grants admin/merchandiser and bypasses every owner check
Webhook processor confirms orders without checking paid amount/currency against the order, and creates orders from payload
No event_id idempotency: replayed payment.succeeded decrements stock and re-confirms repeatedly
Stock reservation is read-then-write without row locks (oversell race)
Hardcoded default PAYGATE_SECRET makes worker inbox signatures forgeable when env is unset
Hardcoded fallback PayGate webhook secret
Order owner email and idempotency replay lookup taken from request body, not caller
Order totals use stale cart-captured unit prices instead of the current price list
Sweeper cancels and empties orders with a pending payment, so late payments confirm line-less ghost orders
Verified webhooks are applied without event_id deduplication — replay double-confirms and double-decrements stock
findings.note: Duplicate of the event_id idempotency finding: same root cause. inbox_server only stores rows, and the missing event_id dedup lives in process_pending/apply_event.

incremental_run.action: Scan new commits (after the demo PR was closed unmerged)

new_findings.title: New cart ownership check is bypassed by a self-declared staff role header

incremental_run.note: The one new finding came from a commit that landed on main between the two runs, not from the closed PR.

scans.profile: Kadé Commerce — catalog and checkout hot paths (lab 05)

findings.title: buildProduct issues price + variants + per-variant inventory queries; collection page calls it per product (N+1)
Collection page builds each product with its own sequential queries (N+1)
Checkout transaction issues per-line, per-warehouse and per-split statements while holding locks
GET /admin/carts/abandoned loads lines with one query per cart over an unbounded result
Abandoned-cart sweep: unindexed carts scan, per-cart lines query, and per-cart orders full scan on cart_id
/health loads and row-locks up to 10,000 inbox rows just to count them, under the ingestion lock
save_order deletes and re-inserts every order line one row at a time on each webhook, even when lines are unchanged
PUT /admin/price-lists/:id inserts entries one statement at a time inside a FOR UPDATE transaction
Static brand row re-queried from Postgres on every storefront/cart/admin request
list_orders / _order_from load the entire orders table and query lines per order (reconcile N+1)

scans.dismissed_note_example: Duplicate of the abandoned-cart sweep finding. Missing orders(cart_id)/carts(status, updated_at) indexes are step 1 of the primary's fix.

findings.title: Inventory Adjust −/+ icon buttons have no accessible name
All SPA routes share the static document title "Kadé Commerce"
Price badge text fails contrast minimum (2.8:1)
Text input and select boundaries fail non-text contrast (1.3–1.5:1)
Inventory adjustment result not announced to assistive technology
